name: anamnesis
description: Persistent encrypted memory for OpenAI Codex CLI. Three lifecycle hooks (SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / Stop) capture every session deterministically. Encrypted at rest with per-user HKDF-derived keys, no master key (not yet end-to-end — anamnesis.smtry.ai/security says exactly who can decrypt what). Browse, search, and delete at anamnesis.smtry.ai/memory.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent cross-product memory for your AI.
interface.longDescription: Anamnesis gives your AI a memory pool that is yours, not the vendor's: sessions are captured automatically, distilled into durable memories, and recalled in any connected product (Codex, Claude, Gemini). Encrypted at rest with per-user keys; browse, search, and delete everything at anamnesis.smtry.ai/memory.
